The Display Accommodations family on one product page — related display settings

Color filters vs invert colors vs smart invert

US pages use "Color filters", "Invert colors", or "Smart invert." China storefront copy often uses 颜色滤镜, 反色, or 智能反色 — depending on whether you mean filter presets, classic inversion, or media-aware smart invert. Screenshot galleries often label the comfort slider: "Reduce white point", "Dim bright whites", or slider art under Display Accommodations. zh-Hans overlay lines may use 降低白点 — matching what your English gallery actually shows, not generic 亮度 (brightness) vocabulary that misses the accessibility display sense.
